title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Open Balance of a Disputed Demurrage Line
content:
## Clause

When a billed party disputes a Demurrage and Detention Free Time demurrage line on the ground that rates or free time were misapplied, what it disputes is the amount still open on that line. It is measured as the line's invoiced figure reduced by all the waivers, those granted by the operations department among them, and all the dispute credits recorded so far with this line named as the line they reduce; it cannot go below nothing.

## Input, judgement, output

| Entries on the account | Counted against the line? |
|---|---|
| the demurrage invoice line itself | the figure the reduction starts from |
| a goodwill waiver referencing the line | yes, deducted |
| a waiver granted by the operations department referencing the line | yes, deducted |
| an earlier dispute credit referencing the line | yes, deducted |
| a card payment on the record | no; it references no invoice line |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Demurrage line 1100.00; operations waiver of 200.00 against it: 900.00 still open.
- Demurrage line 600.00; no entries against it: 600.00 still open.

This open balance is the starting point from which the disputed amount is derived.
